A little about me

Learning by building.

A practical, project-focused approach to growing in data and AI.

I graduated in Computer Science from the Institute of Computing at Kohat University of Science and Technology (KUST), Pakistan. That’s where my interest in building software really started to grow.

These days I’m most curious about data analysis, machine learning, deep learning, and large language models. I’ve started exploring LangChain and LangGraph because I want to understand how AI apps and agent-based workflows actually come together.

I’m happiest when I’m learning by doing: working through problems, experimenting with new tools, and keeping up with what’s new in technology.
